v1Scope: v1 is a runnable, measurable single-Worker "company brain" for 1-2 internal-dogfood tenants on ONE shared D1 and two provisioned Vectorize V2 indexes (brain-chunks, brain-entities, both bge-m3/1024d). The FULL multi-tenant isolation model ships (org→team→user→scope, Scoped* chokepoints, D1 re-check, namespace=tenantId) and is proven by a blocking isolation canary suite; horizontal scale-out is deferred (tenant_shards columns present but resolve to one shard, no fan-out logic). v1 delivers: document + session ingestion (extract→chunk→embed→KG-extract→dual-index), hybrid search (FTS5 bm25 ∥ Vectorize → RRF → bge-reranker → token-budget-guarded cited synthesis via `think`), the two-graph model (pages/doc_links + entities/entity_relations bridged by entity_mentions) with BFS traversal, governed memory (trust grades, append-only audit + recall traces, human-only promotion to instruction), Clerk OAuth 2.1 auth, and four thin surfaces (Hono REST/tRPC API, MCP server, brain CLI, TanStack dashboard) over a single Zod op-registry. App-level token_spend 429 pre-check is the enforcing cost cap (MONTHLY_COST_CEILING_USD default 400). DEFERRED out of v1: D1/Vectorize shard fan-out, frozen-snapshot injection (brain_snapshots/get_session_context snapshot_id accepted but stubbed/omitted), Phase-3.5 cross-session semantic entity dedup, DO-per-tenant working memory, BYO/openai-compatible provider routing (seam only), AI Gateway spend enforcement (attribution only). Success = `think` returns cited evidence over an ingested doc AND the isolation canary suite is green.

monorepo.purpose: Single source of truth: canonical Principal contract, Zod tool/op schemas, model constants (EMBEDDING_MODEL/DIMS, GENERATION/RERANK/EXTRACT), graph contracts (GraphNode/GraphPath/EdgeSpec + DOC_GRAPH/ENTITY_GRAPH consts), IngestionParams.

Drizzle D1 schema + migrations + FTS5 trigger DDL; the ONLY module allowed to import raw env.DB/Vectorize/R2; houses ScopedDB/ScopedVectorize/ScopedR2, hybrid-search helpers (fts/vector/rrf/rerank/synthesis-budget), embed()/gen()/rerank() chokepoints, ai-gateway + ops-metrics wrappers.

Platform-neutral Importer SDK (begin/nextBatch/finalize, runImporterContract) lifted from openbrains minus Convex; fingerprint/normalize, source adapters (gmail, ob1, github, net-new chatgpt + claude-code), workers-ai embeddings wrapper.

The single deployed Worker: Hono REST + tRPC router, MCP Durable Object (BrainMCP/McpAgent), webhook /ingest, OAuth transport, all Workflow classes (Enumerator/BatchIngest/EntityExtraction/SessionPromote), all Queue consumers (brain-backfill/brain-reembed +DLQs), scheduled() cron. resolvePrincipal at the edge.
`brain` Commander program acting as a tRPC client over appRouter; OAuth 2.1 device-flow auth, --tenant/-t selector, --json output.

TanStack Start + shadcn dashboard; co-located in apps/api Worker for v1 (no Service Binding), createServerFn data layer calling scoped services directly; Clerk auth, server-side session-pinned tenant.

verticalSlice: Provision env: apply D1 migrations, create brain-chunks + brain-entities Vectorize indexes and their metadata indexes, create R2 bucket + KV + Queues, wire Clerk JWKS; seed one org (tenant) + one membership (user) with allowedScopes='*'.
Authenticate: brain CLI device-flow login → resolvePrincipal resolves Clerk JWT + active tenant → Principal bound to the one tenant.

Ingest: POST /ingest (or doc upload) a markdown document for the tenant → handler fingerprints, writes body to R2 under ${tenantId}/, inserts documents row (status pending), triggers BatchIngestWorkflow id ingest-${tenantId}-${fingerprint}.

Workflow: extract → chunk → store chunks (tenant_id/scope/visibility=world, FTS5 via triggers) → embed-batch via bge-m3 (assert 1024d) → ScopedVectorize.upsert namespace=tenantId → KG-extract entities → finalize status indexed.

Search: call MCP `think` (or tRPC) with a question → embed(query) → FTS bm25 arm ∥ Vectorize arm (namespace=tenant) → both id sets JOIN back through ScopedDB and re-checked (cross-tenant/out-of-scope dropped) → RRF fuse → trust/title boost → bge-reranker → token-budget-guarded cited synthesis.

Measurable result: `think` returns {answer, evidence[], citations[]} citing the ingested document's slug, one memory_recall_trace row written per kept hit; AND the 15-canary isolation suite (a second tenant's colliding-slug content is never returned across vector/FTS/recall arms) is green.
invariants: Every isolatable D1 row carries tenant_id NOT NULL; every vector is namespace=tenantId (never userId); every R2 key is ${tenantId}/-prefixed — no single-tenant shortcuts even with one user.
All tenant data is reached ONLY through ScopedDB/ScopedVectorize/ScopedR2; raw env.DB/Vectorize/R2 bindings are importable ONLY inside packages/db, enforced by a blocking ESLint banned-import rule.

Isolation does NOT rest on the Vectorize namespace (CF doesn't document it as a security boundary): it rests on (a) un-omittable hard-wired ScopedVectorize wiring and (b) the mandatory D1 row re-check after every vector AND FTS hit, which silently DROPS cross-tenant / out-of-scope / deleted / out-of-visibility ids (drop-don't-error, no existence leak).

FTS5 external-content tables (chunks_fts/entity_fts/facts_fts) carry NO tenant_id; MATCH stays pure text and every result JOINs back to the tenant-scoped base table before any row leaves the keyword arm — a MATCH-then-unscoped-read is a forbidden leak path.
Two axes never conflated: allowedScopes (DATA partition, read by ScopedDB/ScopedVectorize) vs capabilities read/write/admin (read by scopeSatisfied/readOnly); separately sourced, separately consumed.

trust_grade is NEVER a chunks column nor a Vectorize metadata field — it lives only in the memory_use_policy sidecar, LEFT-JOINed at read (default 'evidence'); a trust promotion never rewrites a chunk or re-upserts a vector.
trust_grade and visibility stay orthogonal: trust_grade∈{instruction,evidence,draft} (agent behaviour) vs visibility∈{private,team,world} (access control).

visibilityPredicate is un-omittable at the chokepoint on every default read of a visibility-bearing row (facts AND chunks): world OR (team AND team_id∈teamIds) OR (private AND user_id=p.userId); owner/admin do NOT bypass it except via audited+alerted break-glass that fails closed for non-admins and never bypasses tenant_id.
Agent writeback CANNOT set instruction (hard-wired evidence, no arg exists); promotion to instruction flows exclusively through a human-confirmed memory_review row.

memory_audit and memory_recall_traces are append-only (no UPDATE/DELETE in app code); audit row is written in the SAME db.batch as the change it records; recall-trace writes are off the synchronous read path (ctx.waitUntil) because D1 is single-writer.
No interactive cross-await D1 transactions — atomicity is via db.batch([...]) only; D1 batches respect the 100 bound-param cap (CHUNK_DB_BATCH_SIZE=10).

bge-m3 1024d is locked; a dim-changing model swap is refused at the embed() assertion; foreign-dimension vectors (qwen3, OB1/OpenAI 1536d) are RE-EMBEDDED never copied (same-dimension is not interchangeability).
Bodies/transcripts live ONLY in R2 (body_r2_key/r2_key); D1 holds index+lean rows + preview (markdown_preview ≤2000) only — a correctness requirement for the single shared D1 under its byte budget.

embed()/gen()/rerank() NEVER throw — they return null/RRF-order/[] and degrade to keyword-only or evidence-without-synthesis; write-path embed failure throws to trigger Workflow retry (never silently indexes un-embedded chunks).

Deterministic Workflow ids (ingest-${tenantId}-${fingerprint}, promote-${tenantId}-${sessionId}, kg-${tenantId}-${documentId}) make re-triggers/at-least-once delivery idempotent; durable dedup correctness rests on the (tenant_id,scope,fingerprint) UNIQUE index, not the instance id.

token_spend pre-check returns 429+Retry-After BEFORE env.AI.run (the enforcing cost cap); AI Gateway spend limits are attribution-only for the all-@cf/ v1 model set, though every call is still proxied with tenant_id metadata.

No bare token below the edge: resolvePrincipal runs once at the edge and a Principal is threaded everywhere below; tenant comes from the pinned mechanism (slug/header/session-pin), never the JWT alone, and 401 (never a silent first-membership default) when unspecified.

No shared internal HTTP secret: internal Worker↔Workflow/Queue hops use native bindings; handlers still reconstruct a Principal from explicit tenant_id and go through Scoped*; consumers validate message tenant_id vs a real orgs row (fail-closed to DLQ).

pages is the ONLY doc-graph node space (doc_links.from_id/to_id are always pages.id); the KG is a separate graph; the two are joined only by the entity_mentions bridge — never a single polymorphic nodes/edges table; entities are {team,world} only (no private tier) with scope partitioned into the dedup key.
Reranker index→chunk remap is a hard blocking CI/deploy gate; until green for a Workers AI version, rerank degrades to RRF order (a wrong remap mis-attributes a citation = correctness bug).

Idle-session promotion keys on last_activity_at (refreshed every capture_turn), NOT ended_at (which may stay NULL on a missed Stop-hook); re-finalizing a session is a clean replace (soft-expire prior promoted facts for source_session_id, preserve lineage), never an append.

tenant_shards columns ship but resolve to ONE shard; Vectorize ceilings (10M vectors / 50k namespaces) and the D1 6 GB trigger are NON-BINDING documented Phase-N triggers with no sharding logic in v1.
mustAskDecisions: Tenant/solo-user onboarding model: auto-provision an org on first Clerk login (org==user) vs admin-provisioned only / explicit create-join. This shapes the phase-1 frozen tenancy schema and resolvePrincipal, so it must be decided before phase 1 freezes.

Machine-token (bdev_) tenancy model: one tenant-baked token per tenant vs tenantId as a per-request selector against an authenticated Clerk JWT. This touches the frozen resolvePrincipal resolution chain.
Production custom-domain hostnames (api.brain.example.com / staging are placeholders) — needed before the production deploy in the runbook.
Per-tenant MONTHLY_COST_CEILING_USD override values (the $400 default exists; per-tenant overrides do not) — needed before any env.AI.run path is exercised against a real budget.
Promotion-to-instruction authority: strictly owner/admin governance, or may a 'member' promote within their own scope? Shapes the governance gate and memory_review write path.
stack: Cloudflare Workers Paid plan ($5/mo; Workers AI billed in Neurons) — single deployed Worker apps/api owning Hono REST router + MCP DO + all Workflows + all Queue consumers + scheduled() cron; compatibility_date 2026-06-01, nodejs_compat.

API: Hono (REST: webhooks, upload, OAuth, MCP transport) + tRPC on Workers (dashboard↔API + CLI; protectedProcedure/writeProcedure chokepoints) + Zod single op-registry generating MCP tools, tRPC procedures, and CLI commands so they cannot drift.

MCP: @modelcontextprotocol McpAgent Durable Object at /mcp/:slug (stateful/SSE, primary) + stateless Streamable-HTTP /mcp as compatibility fallback; DO is protocol instance only, never system of record; DO key pinned per (tenant, slug).
CLI: `brain` via Commander as a tRPC client; OAuth 2.1 device flow (RFC 8628); tokens in ~/.config/brain/config.json with auto-refresh.
Frontend: TanStack Start + shadcn deployed on Workers, co-located in apps/api for v1 (no Service Binding); createServerFn data layer; Clerk auth, server-side session-pinned tenant.

Auth: Clerk as OAuth 2.1 / OIDC upstream IdP (jose jwtVerify vs Clerk JWKS, issuer-checked) + @cloudflare/workers-oauth-provider (KV-backed); machine tokens bdev_ (HMAC-SHA256 via WebCrypto) and API keys bk_ (SHA-256 hashed).

Data: D1 (single shared SQLite DB, Drizzle ORM + migrations, FTS5 external-content trigger-synced tables, db.batch, 100 bound-param cap) + Vectorize V2 (two 1024d cosine indexes, namespace=tenantId, metadata-index filtering, topK max 100) + R2 (tenant-prefixed bodies/transcripts + audit ndjson) + KV (OAUTH_KV) + Durable Objects (BrainMCP, SQLite-backed).

Durable execution: Cloudflare Workflows (Enumerator, BatchIngest, EntityExtraction, SessionPromote; step.do, retries exponential) + Queues (brain-backfill, brain-reembed, each +DLQ) + Cron triggers (*/5).

AI: Workers AI via AI Gateway (env.AI.run gateway option, tenant_id custom metadata) — @cf/baai/bge-m3 (embed 1024d), @cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast (synthesis ~24k ctx), @cf/baai/bge-reranker-base (rerank), @cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct (extract); all behind embed()/gen()/rerank() chokepoints with an AI_PROVIDER=openai-compatible seam reserved (not built).

Quality/ops: ESLint banned-import rule; @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers isolation canary suite + reranker-shape gate as required CI merge checks; Analytics Engine ops metrics; single GitHub Actions pipeline (lint→typecheck→unit→workerd integration/isolation).

Constants: K=60 RRF, COSINE_FLOOR 0.5 / related 0.85, TRUST_BOOST{instruction:2.0,evidence:1.0,draft:0.6}, title boost 1.25x, top-40 candidates / top-k 8-12 (think=12), CHUNK_DB_BATCH_SIZE=10, EMBED_BATCH_SIZE=50, KG_BATCH_SIZE=5, MAX_CHUNKS_PER_DOC=4000, MAX_BODY_BYTES=8MiB, TURN_INLINE_MAX=2KB, /ingest 256KB cap, SYNTHESIS_TOKEN_BUDGET~20000, MONTHLY_COST_CEILING_USD=400.
risks: Security (lowest-scored, 71): the entire isolation guarantee rests on the D1 re-check + un-omittable Scoped* wiring + FTS JOIN-back; any new surface or hand-built WHERE that bypasses a chokepoint silently re-opens cross-tenant/cross-scope/visibility leaks. Mitigation is the blocking ESLint banned-import rule + 15-canary suite gating EVERY merge — these MUST be green at end of phase 1 before any parallel feature work.

Reranker output shape (bge-reranker-base {id,score} indexing) is unpinned by CF docs; a wrong index→chunk remap mis-attributes citations (a correctness bug). Must be locked by a staging integration gate; degrade to RRF order until green.

FTS5 isolation foot-gun: external-content tables have no tenant_id, so copying cf-graph's `MATCH ... AND workspace_id=?` is a leak. The mandatory JOIN re-check on the base table is easy to forget on any new search arm.

D1 single-writer + 6 GB byte budget under audit/recall-trace/chunks-content growth (not bodies, which are offloaded to R2); recall-trace writes must stay off the read path and bodies must stay in R2 or the single shared DB becomes the bottleneck before the deferred shard-out is built.

Workflow step caps: 1 MiB non-stream step.do() output and 10k-step budget force the R2-staging + references-only enumeration patterns; oversized docs must split on chunk boundaries (MAX_CHUNKS_PER_DOC) or a single ingest blows the budget.

Re-embed / foreign-dimension migration: same-dimension is not interchangeability — qwen3/OpenAI 1536d vectors must be re-embedded not copied; the budgeted resumable sweep can starve interactive think traffic if not paced (surface='migration' tag + Queue back-pressure).

Workers AI request-rate ceilings are conservative assumptions unverified until staging; chokepoints must degrade-or-queue rather than 429 the interactive user, and the real ceilings are a Phase-N scale trigger to confirm.

Cross-section contract drift: §3/§4/§5/§6/§7/§8 each claim authority over overlapping DDL/algorithms; the frozen packages/shared + packages/db schema in phase 1 must reconcile them before parallel phases build against diverging assumptions (e.g. memory_* sidecar target_id polymorphism, importer input schemas in §4.7.1).
